# Pagination reference

PAGINATION-FIRST-MARKER: This original fixture exercises ordinary block movement, oversized block splitting and whole-graphic scaling. Its reference layout is A4 with 16 mm margins. The page count and exact ordinary-block position require a recorded reference render.

The short paragraphs below place a following quotation near a page boundary. The quotation is smaller than one printable page. If its height exceeds the space left on its current page, move the quotation to the next page. Do not change this fixture after observing a failure to manufacture a pass.
